own_solution.law: Bernoulli + continuity, manometer: p1 - p2 = (rho_m - rho) g h; Q = A2 sqrt(2 (p1 - p2) / (rho (1 - (A2/A1)^2)))
assumptions: steady, incompressible, inviscid flow with uniform speed (stated)
manometer liquid immiscible and denser than flowing liquid

notes: Base: dp = 12600*9.8*0.12 = 14817.6 Pa; v2^2 (1 - 1/16) = 29.635 -> v2 = 5.622 m/s; Q = 1.9635e-3*5.622 = 0.01104 m^3/s. With 2500 kg/m^3 in the U-tube when the 12 cm is read: dp = 1500*9.8*0.12 = 1764 Pa; v2^2 = 3.528*16/15 = 3.763 -> v2 = 1.940 m/s; Q = 3.809e-3 m^3/s. Refilling after the reading leaves the reading as taken with the 13600 liquid (D). Second manometer is on a different pipe (D). Height of the horizontal pipe axis enters both Bernoulli terms equally and cancels (C). Variant numbers consistent: 2500 kg/m^3 across T6113, T609E, T3597, T2C4F; 2.1 m across TE588, T7E31.
